brief.summary: Equity futures rose, with S&P futures +0.7% and Nasdaq +1%, while oil fell for a fourth session as Brent and WTI retreated. Treasury yields moved lower across the curve and 2s10s flattened to the low 20s, the flattest since March 2025. The Fed backdrop is hawkish: Goolsbee said restoring price stability won't be painless, and BNP expects at least two more hikes, while market pricing leans toward more tightening. The dominant narrative is energy and geopolitics—record diesel, a possible export ban, and diplomacy around UNGA and the Trump-Xi summit. Earnings/AI commentary was positive on broadening growth, but the consumer tone was mixed and risks remain. Overall tone: cautiously risk-on.
notable_quotes: We've reached the point of maximum pain. The dominoes are starting to fall.
Restoring price stability won't be painless; the only way to restore balance is to reduce demand.
